title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Services - PublicService
description: A municipal public service offered by a public administration or by an entity on its behalf (edintserpub:PublicService). NOTE: the source ontology's own generated ontology.ttl has two tooling artifacts affecting this class: its own class IRI is malformed (declared under 'http://www.semanticweb.org/owl/owlapi/turtle#' instead of this ontology's real servicios-publicos# namespace), and it is declared rdfs:subClassOf itself (a tautology). Both ignored here; this entity uses the real servicios-publicos# IRI confirmed by the property domains and the source's own real example data.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PublicService'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A unique code assigned to the service to enable identification across systems (edintserpub:identifier), e.g. 'SP-URB-001'.

availability.description: Property. The current or declared availability of the public service (edintserpub:availability), e.g. channels and periods when it can be accessed. The source ontology does not constrain this to a structured format.

typePublicService.description: Relationship. The category of public service, from the PublicServicesType controlled vocabulary (edintserpub:typePublicService, subproperty of DCAT-AP/CPSV's data.europa.eu/m8g/isClassifiedBy). Kept as a Relationship to the concept URI rather than an enum -- the source's own KOS scheme has ~48 concepts, similar in scale to edint-infraestructura's InfrastructureType.

hasAdministrativeProcedure.description: Relationship. The AdministrativeProcedure through which this service is managed, processed, or resolved (edintserpub:hasAdministrativeProcedure).

hasCompetentAuthority.description: Relationship. The public organization ultimately responsible for managing and providing the service (edintserpub:hasCompetentAuthority, reusing the EU Core Public Service Vocabulary's cv:PublicOrganisation concept per its definition). Not formally declared with an rdfs:domain in the source ontology, but used on PublicService in the source's own real example data.
